scoring.points: min(10, round(10*idealLen/(wordsUsed + clarifierWeight*missingClarifiers))); 0 if the meaning fails

italicMarkup: *word* in a note = a nickname or code word, shown in italics

items.note: Liam, the paddling pool has a hole! Can you bring some tape on Friday so we can fix it?
Mia, great news: the lemonade sold out by noon! Tomorrow we need two jugs, not one. Same spot by the gate, as you know.
Liam, can you take the paint and brushes to the *den* (Mia's garage) by 2pm? We're painting the stall sign.
Raj, please help at the *Castle* (our name for the big sandpit) after school. First sweep up the toys, then put out the chairs.
Liam, someone needs to collect the chairs from school on Friday. Mum is choosing who.
Mia, please keep the back gate shut today. The puppy keeps running out, and Dad hasn't fixed the lock yet.
Amira, the stall sign fell apart! Please bring glue and string to the *den* (Mia's garage) by 12pm, so we can fix it before the fair.
Raj, the puppet show isn't at school any more. It's in the *Lab* now, which is what we call Mia's kitchen. Same time as before: Thursday at 3pm.
Zoey, we're making a bracelet for every kid in our class, so please buy enough beads. Liam is counting the kids.
Liam, jobs for the fair: you run the hoops game, Zoey sells the tickets, and Mia does face painting. There's no cake stand this year.
Zoey, I left my green jumper at your house yesterday. Can you bring it to school tomorrow, please?
Mia, while we're away, please feed Biscuit the cat twice a day. The food is in the blue tin, as you know.
Mia, we voted! Our club name is the Rockets, not the Comets. Meet at *HQ* (the treehouse at 10am) on Saturday to paint the sign.
Amira, the costume box is in the *Cave* (that's what we call the space under the stairs). Please bring the pirate hats for the show.
Liam, please bring a paper cup for every guest at the party on Saturday. Zoey is counting the guests.
Mia, for the picnic, Liam brings the drinks and you bring the cups. I'll make the sandwiches.
Raj, the club meets at *HQ* (the treehouse at 10am) on Sunday. If it's windy, we'll meet in my kitchen instead.
Amira, this Saturday the book sale moves from the hall to the *Corner* (our name for the library steps). More people walk past there.
Zoey, can you pick up Grandpa's tent on Thursday, ready for Friday's camp-out? He'll tell us where it is.
Liam, let's plant the seeds today. First fill the pots with soil, then push in the seeds, then water them. Don't use the hose, it's too strong.
Liam, a customer said our cookies were too sweet. Next time, please use less sugar.
Mia, for the school fair we need 3 folding tables from your garage. As you know, your dad already said yes!
Zoey, football is at the *usual* time and place (Friday at the park, 4pm). If it rains, we'll play in the school hall instead.
Amira, when you get here, go to *Nana's* (we mean the café next door) and ask for the cake box. Carry it back carefully!
Liam, Mum wants you to bring something to our stall at 9am. She'll tell you what.
Mia, for the plant stall, small pots are 2 coins and big pots are 5 coins. Please write the new signs.
Raj, come to football at the *usual* time and place (Friday at the park, 4pm). We warm up first, then pick teams, so wear trainers.
Amira, because of the rain, the yard sale won't be in our garden. It'll be at the *Barn* instead (that's Grandpa's garage), next Sunday at 10am.
Zoey, can you help me take Rocky the dog to the vet this week? Mum is still picking the day.
Liam, if the bus is late, walk to the library and wait inside. Don't wait outside in the rain. I'll meet you there at 4pm.
Liam, the ice-cream van is here until 3pm. Bring coins, not notes.
Mia, art class has moved from Monday to Tuesday. It's still at 5pm, as you know.
Raj, please water the plants in the *Jungle* (that's what we call the back garden).
Liam, please buy 6 more balloons for the party.
Amira, lunch is at the *Nest* today (that's Gran's house). Please be there by noon.
Zoey, the swim race is at the pool this week. Mum will say which day.
Liam, can you fetch something from the shed for Grandpa? He'll say what.
Mia, please bring chairs for everyone at the picnic. Liam is counting heads.
